environment-not-browser.detail: This check only runs meaningfully in the browser.

insecure-context.detail: Web MIDI access needs HTTPS on hosted environments.

api-unavailable.detail: The current browser does not expose navigator.requestMIDIAccess.

available.detail: This browser can request MIDI access and enumerate compatible devices.

error.security: The browser blocked MIDI access for security reasons.
error.aborted: The MIDI access request was interrupted.
error.invalid-state: The MIDI access request could not be completed in the current state.
error.unsupported: The browser does not support this MIDI request.

ui.title: Diagnostics
ui.intro: Request Web MIDI access, verify connected inputs, and capture note and sustain pedal traffic without leaving the browser.
ui.validationHint: Primary validation target: desktop Chrome over HTTPS. This screen remains useful even when no keyboard is connected.
ui.noInputsHint: After permission is granted, compatible devices should appear here automatically. You can keep this page open while connecting a keyboard.
ui.loggingHint: Logging note on, note off, and sustain pedal messages only.
ui.noEventsHint: Press keys or move the sustain pedal after granting access. Unsupported message types are ignored so the log stays focused.
